Senses.Explanation: The grief-measure of the great affair: a mourning as raw as a parent's death, required while the matter is unset and still required once it is settled. Muzhou Daoming speaks the root hall instruction itself — the great affair unset, mourn like this; the great affair settled, still mourn like this — and the anthology keeps the later questioners circling it; Yunwai Xingze rings it as the small-meeting bell for time running out; Yulin Tongxiu lifts the staff, credits the old worthies with the saying, and presses why the settled affair still grieves; and Binya Jian opens a memorial hall service by making the whole pair the sermon before asking the assembly why the settled half mourns. Yezhu Fuhui hangs the pair at the head of a hall address and levels it with a road verse; Chaozong Tongren sings it into paired verse for the patron's memorial service, rootless confusion and idle furniture both under the same grief; Eryin Mi swaps the frame to the great way and voices the double mourning beside his own peaks; and Konggu Daocheng, recounting three years of standing at cliffs and walking open ground, holds the old formula as the thread of the whole striving.
